first.text: A new face. Draughts, blades, rope: if a Hunter needs it, I stock it. Not much of it, mind. What'll it be, {calling}?

choices.text: Let me see what you have.
Teach me to drive a better bargain?

text: Mind the stock. It doesn't grow on trees.

choices.text: Then let me see what you have.
